# 1.01
Write a program that reads two integers and prints the first minus the second.

Input: one line, two integers separated by a space.
Output: one line, the first minus the second.
Limits: -1000 ≤ each integer ≤ 1000.

## Examples
```in
9 4
```
```out
5
```
## Solution
```cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <print>

int main()
{
    //: Read the two numbers.
    int first {0};
    int second {0};
    std::cin >> [[first >> second]];
    //: Print the value.
    std::println("{}", [[first - second]]);
}
```
## Slow
```cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <print>

int main()
{
    int first {0};
    int second {0};
    std::cin >> first >> second;
    int difference {0};
    while (second + difference < first) {
        ++difference;
    }
    while (second + difference > first) {
        --difference;
    }
    std::println("{}", difference);
}
```


## Large
```cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <print>

int main()
{
    int seed {0};
    std::cin >> seed;
    std::println("{} {}", seed * 7 - 500, 400 - seed * 13);
}
```
Seeds: 1, 2
